# Google Play release notes for the next build (at most 500 characters).
# Lines starting with # are ignored.

• A slimmer message bar, one date marker per day, and unsent messages kept when you leave a chat or Keyring locks.
• A new Contact Details screen, and how you know someone, one entry per day.
• After an inactivity lock, Keyring returns to the screen you were on.
• Communities set up on your agent with pnm or openvtc can be brought back to the phone, with a count of cards read.
• Many more screens in French and Portuguese.
